QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Please Find Dargoth Some Snacks
QuestInfo.0: Black Wings' secretary #b#p2154002##k at the #m310050000# in the Mine is still struggling with so many things to do. Talk to #p2154002#.
QuestInfo.1:
This time, #p2154002# needs a snack for Dargoth. Help #p2154002# find Dargoth a snack. Dargoth likes to eat #b#t4034074##k found in #r#o7150001##k. Why don't they keep more of this around?

#i4034074# #t4034074# #b#c4034074#/40#k
QuestInfo.2:
When you delivered #t4034074#, #p2154002# was extremely happy. Dargoth...isn't human, right? Humans can't eat like that!

In any case, the Black Wings don't appear to be all that vicious.

0.0: Hello. I am #p2154002#, the always busy Black Wing secretary. I wish I could offer you a... Huh?!
0.1: It looks like we've run out of snacks! Dargoth has a bad habit of breaking down walls and eating the steel inside if he's not fed on time, and I'm sick of wasting money on repairs. Do you think you can help?

yes.0: Can you defeat the #r#o7150001# enemies#k at the #b#m310050600##k and bring back some #b#t4034074##k? Yeah, that's Dargoth's favorite snack. I wouldn't suggest trying it yourself.

no.0: Oh, are you busy? I figured that since you're new and you haven't been assigned to guard anything, you'd have some time on your hands. I guess I was wrong. Can you tell me what you've been assigned to?

1.0: Hey look, it's the #t4034074# items! Thank you so much. Now I won't have to worry about Dargoth eating the walls or the table. That deserves a reward!

yes.0: Help me again, okay?The bosses have strange personalities so there's a lot of things that need taking care of.

item.0: I really need #b40 #t4034074#s#k. Eliminate some #r#o7150001#s#k in #b#m310050600##k to get enough #t4034074#s to make sure nothing ELSE gets eaten.
